Confirm who you are speaking to.

If you already have a number, read it back and ask for a yes: "I have you on
{{caller_phone}}, is that the right number?" Do not act on it until they agree.

If they say no, or you have no number, ask for the one they want to use.

Either way, finish by calling the finish tool with the number they agreed to, so
the rest of the call can use it.
